##### Project General Facts

Wasl 1 Park Views Residences Tower A embodies the essence of refined living, where every day is a masterclass in elegance and sophistication. This distinctive residence is characterized by its modern architectural design, which blends seamlessly into the serene landscape of Zabeel Park, creating a symphony of aesthetics and functionality. The meticulously crafted apartments at Wasl 1 Park Views Residences Tower A offer a luxurious and sophisticated experience, tailored to suit a diverse range of preferences and lifestyles, with each home boasting elegant outdoor spaces and cutting-edge amenities.

The architecture concept at Wasl 1 Park Views Residences Tower A is designed for exquisite tastes, unlike any other, with a wealth of amenities and spectacular features in one, two, three, and four-bedroom apartments to indulge in. Natural wood, brushed stainless steel, and marble decorations transform each area into a cosy sanctuary, creating an atmosphere of opulent relaxation and refined sophistication. Every aspect of Wasl 1 Park Views Residences Tower A, from its exquisite array of living spaces to its beautifully designed kitchens, is designed to provide residents with a luxurious and wholesome experience, surrounded by the finest amenities and a deep sense of wellbeing.

The interiors of Wasl 1 Park Views Residences Tower A's apartments are distinguished by their modern interior design, which combines a high level of comfort with panoramic full-wall windows offering breathtaking views of Zabeel Park. With a combination of composite cladding, aluminium curtain wall, and typical tinted double glass with aluminium window frames, as well as empowering district cooling and porcelain tiles in the living, dining, kitchen, bedroom, and balcony areas, each home is a masterpiece of design excellence, offering residents a refined and comfortable living environment that embodies the essence of Wasl 1 Park Views Residences Tower A's distinctive lifestyle.

Dubai is a city that caters to every need, with a wide range of services and amenities available at every doorstep, from retail and dining outlets to leisure and entertainment facilities.

The strategic location of Dubai ensures that residents of Wasl 1 Park Views Residences Tower A have access to a plethora of amenities, including iconic landmarks and premium facilities, all within easy reach. With its perfect blend of old and new, Dubai offers a lifestyle that is both luxurious and laid-back, with something for every member of the family to enjoy. From the stunning views of Zabeel Park to the vibrant atmosphere of the city, Dubai is a place where residents can live life to the fullest.

Dubai's unique charm lies in its ability to offer a premium lifestyle, with a wide range of services and amenities at every resident's disposal. With its hassle-free options and variety of access, residents of Wasl 1 Park Views Residences Tower A can enjoy a life that is truly premium, with every need catered to and every desire fulfilled. From the luxury facilities to the iconic outlook and appearance, Dubai is a city that has something for everyone, making it the perfect place to call home.
